reason: I would try the free plan maybe, but I am not paying $19 a month to let a bot talk to my clients until I know where their details go. Client names, phone numbers and health details are not something I want sitting with a third party I have never heard of.
objection: Data privacy and GDPR for client details. I need to know where chat data is stored, whether it is used to train AI, and whether you will sign a data processing agreement.
would_change_my_mind: A written GDPR data processing agreement, clear storage location, and a statement that our chat data is not used to train models, plus proof the calendar booking does not expose other clients' details.
